authorProcess.drafting: Twenty cases composed in group order before assigning IDs. IDs assigned only after deterministic shuffle.

shuffle.algorithm: Fisher-Yates with xorshift32 unsigned state; j=nextUint32() modulo (i+1)

validation.utf16Bounds: All example quotes have 4–120 JavaScript UTF-16 code units

limitations: AI authorship and self-checking do not constitute independent review or human adjudication.
All scenarios are fictional; words such as real and actual describe the fictional case's asserted scope.

authorProcess.sealed: Author case content and labels withheld from implementer until implementation frozen.

review.limitations: AI-authored and separately blind AI-reviewed labels/semantic criteria, not human adjudication. Examples establish assessed single-span feasibility, not a whitelist. Correlated errors remain possible. Set is now seen.

implementationFreeze.design: paired v9 versus v10; exact-quote mechanics plus separate blind AI semantic output review

armOrder: previous/updated on odd case positions, updated/previous on even; fixed shuffled cases
